description: Controversy surrounding the installation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) enabled cameras across Kerala, as part of the Safe Kerala project under the Motor Vehic
body_lead: Controversy surrounding the installation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) enabled cameras across Kerala, as part of the Safe Kerala project under the Motor Vehicles Department, has taken a new turn with the Opposition parties in the state alleging that one of the companies involved in the execution of the project has links to a relative of Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan.
